title: Casholoco Direct — expérimental
description: Play Casholoco directly with friends: the host's browser runs the game. Manually exchange connection codes; no game server, signalling service, STUN or TURN. The same local network is recommended. Internet connectivity is not guaranteed. French and English.
controls: Host: create a match and send one invitation code to each guest, then paste each returned answer.
Guest: paste the host's invitation and return your answer code using a trusted channel.
Mouse or touch: manage your company. Each connected human chooses Ready to close the quarter.
Keep the host tab open. This prototype does not reconnect or migrate a match after reloading a tab.
